report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with no 502s; only two requests (~297ms, ~283ms) were slow, and the p95 of 412ms may reflect histogram bucket granularity. No error signal supports http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or bad-configuration. Downstream latency is plausible but unsubstantiated: dependency metrics are empty and no order-side data exists. Insufficient evidence to name a bounded root cause.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for gateway->order calls (simulator_dependency_operations_total returned empty)
Order service server-side latency and error metrics to localize the 297ms/283ms checkout outliers
Baseline p95 latency for /v1/checkout to determine whether 412ms p95 is anomalous
Trace spans for the slow checkout requests to attribute time to order/inventory/payment/postgresql
